spans.text: [20] AR: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ EN: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you.

[19] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا EN: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
It is better and greater in reward.

folded.id: leave me|with|[the matter of] the deniers
folded.subject: leave Me

spans.text: [11] AR: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا EN: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

folded.id: recite what|is|easy [for you] of the qur'an
folded.subject: recite what

spans.text: He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an.

folded.id: recite what|is|easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan allah a goodly loan
folded.subject: recite what
folded.object: easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan

spans.text: So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan.
And seek forgiveness of Allah.

folded.id: so we|seized|him with a ruinous seizure
folded.subject: so We

spans.text: [16] AR: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا EN: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
[13] AR: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا EN: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

folded.id: that there|will|be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of allah and others fighting for the cause of allah
folded.subject: that there
folded.object: be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah

spans.text: He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah.

folded.id: that you|will|not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness
folded.subject: that you
folded.object: not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness

spans.text: He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an.

folded.id: the earth|and|the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down
folded.subject: the earth
folded.object: the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down

spans.text: [14] AR: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا EN: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
[18] AR: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا EN: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

folded.id: the hours|of|the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words
folded.subject: the hours
folded.object: the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

spans.text: [6] AR: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا EN: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.

folded.id: the lord|of|the east and the west
folded.subject: the Lord

spans.text: [9] AR: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا EN: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

folded.id: the name|of|your lord and devote yourself to him with [complete] devotion
folded.subject: the name
folded.object: your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion

spans.text: [8] AR: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا EN: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
[4] AR: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا EN: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
[11] AR: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا EN: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

[9] AR: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا EN: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

folded.id: they say|and|avoid them with gracious avoidance
folded.subject: they say

spans.text: [10] AR: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا EN: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
[19] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا EN: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
[11] AR: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا EN: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

folded.id: two thirds|of|the night or half of it or a third of it
folded.subject: two thirds
folded.object: the night or half of it or a third of it

spans.text: [20] AR: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ EN: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you.

folded.id: we have|sent|to you a messenger as a witness upon you just as we sent to pharaoh a messenger
folded.subject: We have
folded.object: to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا EN: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

folded.id: we|will|cast upon you a heavy word
folded.subject: We
folded.object: cast upon you a heavy word

spans.text: [5] AR: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا EN: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
[12] AR: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا EN: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah.
